manual:
Each slot on the strip gives one digit, from its mark and its colour:
| mark \ colour | blue | green | yellow |
|---|---|---|---|
| ᖉ | 6 | 3 | 3 |
| ⵘ | 3 | 1 | 6 |
| ꙅ | 5 | 1 | 6 |

The keypad locks everything behind it. Enter its 3 digits in
order first: anything behind it, touched while it is still locked, goes off.

| light | cut wire color |
|---|---|
| blue | green |
| green | blue |
| red | yellow |
